venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Baugh is the play. Philo gets it out. The defense still has to finish.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — board voice rewrite for Charles. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner handed it to Baugh and threw it when the look was there. White’s people took the ball three times and still let FAU stay on the field. That is Saturday.

offense.body:
Baugh is the play. Fourteen carries, 160 yards, three scores. He hits it north. If the first man is there he is already outside. If they step down to help, he is gone — that is the 61. The line is moving people. The wideouts stay on their guys after the catch and after the handoff. That is how a run keeps going.

Philo keeps it on schedule. Sixteen of 21, 275, three touchdowns, no sacks. The ball is out. Wilson. Stockton. Harpring. Brown after the catch — six for 117, and the long one is a throw that is there plus a miss, then he is in space. Abrams is the go. Sixty-three, in stride, after they crowd the run. Clark is not a breather. Eight for 65. He runs, and he scores when they forget he can leave the backfield.

The snap goes over Baugh’s head. That is 2nd-and-forever. Baugh gets 25 of it back. Philo walks it in from the 3. That is the night too. The pick before the half comes off Mays and Sweeney has it. This offense lives when the ball leaves Philo’s hand. It dies when it stays.
bullets: Baugh 14-160-3. North, bounce, gone when they step down.
Philo 16/21. Ball out. Abrams in stride. Brown after the catch.
Clark runs. The snap is a mess. Baugh and Philo still finish it.

defense.body:
Ninety plays. Three hundred ninety-six yards. Sumrall called it atrocious. FAU can throw it short and stay on the field because the corners are not pressed. Veltkamp got to 34 completions that way. That is the tax.

They still take the ball. Coleman is in the window when Veltkamp holds it. Johnson goes up and gets the next one. Bett rips it off him on the keep and Myles Johnson is on it. Three takeaways. Three stops on fourth down. James is in the backfield. Lyons is in the backfield. Graham is running.

The points they gave are the ones you have to finish in your own yard. The pile at the 1. The end leaves and Veltkamp walks in. Flowers loses the back corner and Valsin scores. Same defense. Those three jobs. Campbell will throw it short and run the quarterback. Tackle the first. Stay outside on the second.
bullets: Ninety plays. They give the short throw. That is how FAU stays on the field.
Coleman, Johnson, Bett take the ball. James and Lyons show up.
The 21 is the pile, the keep, and the fade.

specials.body: The drive stalls. They take the points. Durkin from 53. Florida never punts.

keys: Philo lives when the ball is out. The Mays-Sweeney pick is the other side.
They take the ball. They still have to finish the yard and the quarterback run.
Campbell will throw it short and keep it.

nextWeek.look: They will go fast and throw it short. Baugh is still the play. The end stays home when Sixkiller keeps it.
